info.title: OpenAsy Chat
info.description: Channels, threads, direct messages, files and search on the company's own Matrix server (Synapse), with channels set in chat.yaml and guests, retention, legal holds and exports. The messages stay on the Matrix server; a person's routes act as that person there. Every member talks; viewers read the channels and the file; admins also set the rules of channels people made, export for legal requests and manage members and tokens.

apiToken.description: An API token made under Settings, API tokens.

homeserver.description: Where Element and other Matrix apps reach the server.

app.description: The app's name when an app of the file posted it.

encrypted.description: End-to-end encrypted: only the people's own Matrix apps read it.

guestsAllowed.description: Guests from outside the company may be invited to it.

invited.description: Invited and not joined yet; opening it joins.

from.description: Where the members come from, as the file names them.
